name: Airline passengers · monthly
description: Classic Box-Jenkins series: international airline passengers per month (thousands), 1949-1960. Strong trend and growing seasonality, no covariates.

name: Bike sharing · daily rentals
description: Capital Bikeshare (Washington DC), total rentals per day, 2011-2012. Holidays, working days and weather are covariates known in advance (weather = forecast).
notes: Future weather is unknown: the forecast assumes the same weather as one year earlier (shown faded).
A few near-empty days (e.g. Hurricane Sandy, 22 rentals) make MAPE explode, so WAPE is the headline metric.
